note: Wording, not behaviour. "Added once per burning stage" was being read as "adjusted one time" - the pressure-thrust term is actually recomputed at every step of the burn, so the extra thrust grows continuously as the rocket climbs (2.9069 N on an 8,800 ft pad rising to 4.3392 N at 5,420 ft on one 7-second burn). "Once per stage" was only ever about how many nozzle areas are counted at each step. Also corrects a claim in the v0.119 note: the app does NOT deliberately differ from RASAero outside the burn - measured 0.00000000 N across 8,515 rows, it matches exactly.
